bullets.text: Owned end-to-end frontend delivery of a core React and TypeScript workflow from design through API integration, automated testing and release.
Created reusable UI components and integrated REST APIs with automated tests using Vitest and Playwright.
Worked with product, backend and QA colleagues in iterative release cycles and documented shared implementation patterns.
Created storyboards and short demo videos to explain user workflows and product features to developers and customers.
Developed responsive data-heavy interfaces and reusable frontend components, reducing repetitive implementation effort by 40%.
Improved maintainability through component refactoring, automated testing and documentation — passionate about teamwork → results.
